description: Find the historical market states most similar to a ticker on a given date — k nearest neighbors in the 22-dimensional regime vector space across ~3M ticker-days (2014→present). Returns {ticker, date, similarity} triples. The query nobody else sells. Params: ticker (required), at YYYY-MM-DD (default: latest), k (default 15, max 200). Free with X-ORKID-API-Key or $0.02 USDC/call via x402.

at.description: Reference date YYYY-MM-DD (asof: last trading day ≤ at)

name: sv_similar
title: Regime Similarity Search
